stories.headline: Belgium issues visas to Taliban delegation for E.U. meeting
stories.summary: Belgium has issued visas to a Taliban delegation to attend a migration meeting in Brussels, marking the first visit by Taliban representatives to an EU-hosted event since the group returned to power in Afghanistan in 2021. The Belgian foreign ministry confirmed that five visas were issued with limited territorial validity and limited duration, only allowing the delegation to stay in Belgium for a single day. The exact date of the visit has not been disclosed. The meeting is aimed at discussing migration issues, including the deportation of Afghan nationals. European Commission counterparts are set to meet with the Taliban delegation to address these concerns. The visas were issued to facilitate the meeting, which is seen as a significant development in EU-Taliban relations.

stories.headline: AI becomes a top global concern
stories.summary: Artificial intelligence has become a top global concern, with 56% of respondents ranking it as a very or extremely important risk, a 5% increase. In North America, 71% of respondents share this concern. A recent report by Thales found that 61% of respondents across 20 markets and 17 industries ranked AI as their top data security threat. The report also highlighted concerns about the pace of AI development, with 70% citing the speed of change. Microsoft leaders have noted that advancements in AI models and data centers are intensifying concerns around energy and water demand. The annual global threat assessment report now treats AI more prominently, reflecting its growing importance in the global threat landscape. These findings indicate a significant shift in global perceptions of AI as a major concern.

stories.headline: The Rosetta Stone was taken from Egypt. This artist took it back
stories.summary: The Rosetta Stone, taken from Egypt, has been a focal point in calls for the return of ancient artifacts. Egypt's top antiquities official has stated that thousands of Egyptian artifacts can remain in British museums, but the Rosetta Stone must be returned. The Grand Egyptian Museum's opening has reignited demands for restitution, with former officials and Egyptologists supporting the cause. Egyptian campaigners consider this a turning point in their bid to see ancient artifacts returned. Britain has been asked to return the Rosetta Stone, with Egypt rowing back on demands for other antiquities held in British museums. The issue has sparked debate, with some arguing that Egypt does not need the Rosetta Stone, while others emphasize its cultural significance and the need for its return. Egypt continues to push for the stone's repatriation.

stories.headline: "We're Not Asking": South African Activist Group Demands Jobs for Citizens at Expense of Foreigners
stories.summary: A South African activist group stormed a company, demanding that foreign nationals be replaced with local citizens. The group insisted that jobs should be given to citizens regardless of whether they have a CV or not. This incident highlights the ongoing issue of unemployment and tensions between locals and foreigners in South Africa. The group's actions are part of a broader movement to prioritize job opportunities for citizens over foreign workers. The incident has drawn attention to the complex relationships between employment, immigration, and economic development in the country. The activist group's demands reflect the frustrations of many South Africans who feel that foreign workers are taking jobs that could be filled by citizens.

stories.headline: [GSMArena.com] Samsung Galaxy Watch9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 details leak They're both expected to launch next month. According to a new rumor from a tipster on X, the upcoming Samsung Galaxy Watch9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 will...
stories.summary: Samsung's Galaxy Watch9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 are expected to launch on July 22 at a Galaxy Unpacked event. A recent rumor from a tipster on X has leaked details about the upcoming devices. The Galaxy Watch9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 have already received 3C certification, revealing their charging speeds. Additionally, alleged colorways for the models have been shared, although the exact colors for the Galaxy Watch9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 were not specified in the latest leak. The devices have also received new certifications, suggesting they are nearing release. The Galaxy Unpacked event will reportedly feature the new Galaxy Watch models, as well as the Galaxy Z Fold. The launch is expected to take place next month, with official announcements and details to be confirmed by Samsung.

stories.headline: [Forbes] iOS 27: New Advanced AI Dictation Feature Is Turned Off In iPhone Beta The first developer beta of iOS 27 is out for the iPhone. But, so far, one key part of the new Apple Intelligence is turned off by default.
stories.summary: The first developer beta of iOS 27 for iPhone has been released, featuring a new advanced AI Dictation feature. However, this feature is currently turned off by default. The AI Dictation is part of Apple's upcoming Apple Intelligence, set for general release in September. Although it's not enabled in the beta version, users can still explore other new Siri AI features. The advanced AI Dictation feature is specifically designed for the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone Air. To use the feature, users will need to enable it manually, as it is not activated by default in the iOS 27 beta. The feature is expected to bring significant improvements to dictation capabilities on iPhone devices when it becomes available.

stories.headline: [StorageReview.com] AMD Spartan UltraScale+ SU200P FPGA Enters Volume Production AMD Spartan UltraScale+ SU200P FPGA enters volume production in July 2026, adding high I/O, PCIe Gen4 and PQC CNSA 2.0 security.
stories.summary: AMD's Spartan UltraScale+ SU200P FPGA is entering volume production in July 2026. The SU200P is the largest device in the Spartan UltraScale+ family, offering high I/O, PCIe Gen4, and advanced security features, including PQC CNSA 2.0. Built on a 16 nm FinFET process, this FPGA expands AMD's cost-optimized portfolio, targeting embedded and industrial applications. The device features high-speed transceivers, substantial memory, and low-power consumption. With its advanced capabilities, the SU200P provides hardware designers with a larger and more capable part for low-power applications. The entry into volume production follows earlier announcements and production stages, solidifying AMD's position in the FPGA market with a focus on security, performance, and power efficiency. The SU200P's features make it suitable for a range of applications requiring high performance and advanced security.

stories.headline: [Samsung] Samsung Launches The Frame Hospitality Model at HITEC 2026 4K QLED hospitality display brings art-inspired design, guest services and connected management to premium hotels and commercial spaces
stories.summary: Samsung has launched The Frame Hospitality Model at HITEC 2026, a 4K QLED display designed for premium hotels and commercial spaces. The device serves as both a premium display and a design feature, offering artwork, entertainment, and connected hotel services to guest rooms and shared spaces. The Frame brings art-inspired design, guest services, and connected management to the hospitality industry. It is the world's first Art TV for hotels, providing an immersive experience for guests. The launch at HITEC 2026 marks the global introduction of The Frame to Samsung's hospitality TV lineup, expanding the brand's presence in the commercial display market. The Frame is part of Samsung's 2025 Smart TV lineup, which also includes MICRO LED and Neo QLED 8K models.

stories.headline: Lionel Messi becomes World Cup all-time leading goalscorer As he becomes the top goalscorer in World Cup history, BBC Sport explores how Lionel Messi is still delivering on the biggest stage in his late 30s.
stories.summary: Lionel Messi has become the all-time leading goalscorer in World Cup history, breaking Miroslav Klose's 12-year record. At 38 years and 363 days old, Messi scored his 17th and 18th World Cup goals, surpassing Klose's record. The Argentine star now stands alone with 18 goals, two more than the previous record holder, former Germany striker Miroslav Klose. This achievement solidifies Messi's position among the greatest players in football history. The record was broken on Monday, June 22, with Messi's goals cementing his legacy on the biggest stage in football. He continues to deliver exceptional performances in his late 30s, further establishing his reputation as one of the sport's all-time greats. Messi's new record is a testament to his enduring talent and dedication to the sport.

stories.headline: Mo Salah dropped a statement and it's glorious news for Liverpool Mo Salah dropped a statement on Sunday evening. It's simply fantastic news for Liverpool.
stories.summary: Mohamed Salah has reaffirmed his commitment to Liverpool, delivering a reassuring message to fans about his dedication to the team and their shared goal of winning trophies. Despite previous reports suggesting he would leave the club, Salah expressed his desire to stay at Liverpool with just six months left on his current deal. He has no plans to retire and is passionate about bringing the Premier League and other trophies to the club. This statement comes after a remarkable nine-year chapter at Anfield, where Salah has become a key player. His announcement has brought relief and excitement to Liverpool fans, who were previously bracing for his potential departure at the end of the season. Salah's commitment is a significant boost to the team's prospects and morale.

stories.headline: World Cup: Fernandez and Argentina through to last 32 Enzo Fernandez helped Lionel Messi-inspired Argentina make it two wins from their first two matches at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, guaranteeing they will progress
stories.summary: Argentina has secured a spot in the 2026 FIFA World Cup knockout rounds after winning their first two matches. Enzo Fernandez played a key role in the team's success, which was also inspired by Lionel Messi's performance. With two wins, Argentina has guaranteed their progression to the last 32. This comes after their 2022 World Cup win, where they defeated France 4-2 in a penalty shootout after a 3-3 draw. Messi, now 35, is aiming to win another World Cup title before his retirement, having already achieved success at every level. Argentina's strong start to the tournament has positioned them well for the remainder of the competition. The team's performance has been notable, with Fernandez and Messi being key contributors to their success so far.

stories.headline: NBA Players Union Launches New Brand Designed to Reach Fans The NBA players union representing launched a commercial brand campaign in collaboration with Kendrick Lamar’s creative agency, Project 3.
stories.summary: The National Basketball Players Association (NBPA) has launched a new commercial brand, PLYRS UNTD, designed to reach fans and transform the collective influence of NBA players into products, partnerships, and global business opportunities. The brand launch features a collaboration with Kendrick Lamar's creative agency, Project 3, which debuted a 60-second short film called "Own the Game" at the Cannes festival. The film showcases more than two dozen NBA players. PLYRS UNTD aims to create a platform for NBA players to connect with fans and explore new business ventures. The NBPA represents National Basketball Association players and has partnered with Project 3 to bring this new brand to life, marking a significant step in expanding the players' collective influence beyond the court.

stories.headline: Facial recognition cameras at airports, vital sites to be linked to data fusion centre: CISF DG
stories.summary: The Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) plans to establish a nationwide data fusion centre in Delhi to integrate facial recognition data from major airports. This initiative, under consideration by the Home Ministry, aims to enhance security by linking approximately 1.5 lakh CCTV cameras. Facial recognition cameras at airports will be connected to the centre for real-time monitoring and improved security. The CISF is expanding its security mandate to seaports and developing a hybrid security model. The data fusion centre will serve as a centralized hub to enhance aviation security and passenger convenience through advanced surveillance and real-time monitoring. The integration of facial recognition systems and CCTV cameras will enable the CISF to monitor and respond to security threats more effectively, ultimately improving the overall security and passenger experience at airports.

stories.headline: Republic Summit 2026: 'Every Country Understands That 'Nation First' Is India's Biggest Mantra': PM Modi
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Republic Summit 2026, stating that every country understands "Nation First" is India's biggest mantra. He recently returned from the G7 Summit, where he interacted with world leaders who acknowledge India's prioritization of national interests. Modi emphasized that India has boarded the "Reform Express" and this momentum will accelerate. He vowed to work three times harder for India in his third term, praising the Indian community in the US for connecting the two countries. The Prime Minister reiterated that "Nation First" is the greatest principle guiding India's actions, a fact recognized by every country and leader worldwide. Modi's statements reflect his commitment to prioritizing India's national interests and driving the country's growth and development.

stories.headline: US Approves $482 Million Military Support Package For India's Apache Helicopters, M777 Howitzers
stories.summary: The US has formally notified a proposed $482.2 million Foreign Military Sale to India for sustainment support services and related equipment for Apache helicopters and M777A2 Ultra-Light Howitzers. The package aims to bolster India's military capabilities by providing support for its AH-64E Apache attack helicopters and M777 howitzers. The estimated cost includes services and equipment necessary for maintaining and operating these systems. The US Congress has been notified of the proposed sale, which is expected to enhance India's defense capabilities. The deal covers sustainment support services, including spare parts, training, and logistics support, for the Apache helicopters and M777 howitzers, which are already in use by the Indian military. The sale is subject to approval by the US Congress.

stories.headline: Missing money, SIT probe, Oppn's ‘Ghazni’ attack and Yogi's ‘15 days’ claim: Ayodhya's Ram Temple donation row explained
stories.summary: Allegations of missing donations at the Ayodhya Ram Temple have sparked a controversy, prompting a high-level SIT investigation by the Uttar Pradesh government. The probe was ordered after Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav alleged that several crores of rupees donated to the temple had gone missing. A three-member SIT team arrived in Ayodhya to investigate the misappropriation of donations. Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut claimed that CCTV footage showed a "dacoity" involving over ₹5 crore from temple offerings, accusing the BJP of stealing donations. The Uttar Pradesh government has announced that the process of removing cash from donation boxes will now be videographed. The Ram Temple Trust is also expected to be restructured, with responsibilities distributed equally among all members. The SIT investigation is ongoing, with the Uttar Pradesh government aiming to resolve the matter within 15 days.

stories.headline: Iran Deal Back On Track? Trump, Tehran Agree To 60
stories.summary: The US and Iran have agreed to a roadmap aimed at reaching a final deal within 60 days. The agreement includes a 60-day ceasefire period, during which the parties will negotiate the future of Iran's nuclear program. A memorandum of understanding (MOU) is expected to be signed, followed by a 60-day period without fighting, allowing Iran, the US, Israel, and Lebanon to discuss specific details for a lasting peace deal. The agreement also includes immediate oil export waivers and a $300 billion development framework. Negotiators have established oversight, sanctions, and nuclear working groups to advance talks, with a Lebanon deconfliction mechanism being an early test of the ceasefire. The US special envoy aims to finalize the deal within the 60-day timeframe, despite potential mistrust and resistance from Iranian officials.

stories.headline: Geopolitics, Inflation to Dominate Economic News
stories.summary: Geopolitical tensions and inflation data are expected to dominate economic news. Recent events, including the SpaceX IPO, have shifted attention, but global markets remain driven by geopolitics, with soaring oil prices and volatile bonds. Historically, geopolitical risks have been linked to high inflation, with data since 1900 showing a correlation between the two. Current inflation is predicted to rise modestly before easing, with potential offsets from productivity gains driven by artificial intelligence. The impact of geopolitics on economies is evident, with US officials citing sanctions as a factor in Iran's economic collapse and high inflation. Global markets will likely continue to react to geopolitical developments, making them a key focus for investors and economists. Ongoing tensions and data releases will be closely watched for their potential impact on inflation and the economy.

stories.headline: A purported ceasefire in the U.S.-Iran conflict
stories.summary: The United States and Iran have agreed to a two-week ceasefire, mediated by Pakistan, in the 2026 Iran war. The agreement began on April 8, with Iran proposing a 10-point plan for a peace agreement after rejecting Pakistan's initial 45-day ceasefire proposal. A separate ceasefire in Lebanon started on April 16. Iran, the US, and Israel have agreed to the ceasefire, with Israel stating it will not consider it a time of war if Hezbollah does not attack. The ceasefire in Lebanon was a condition set by Tehran for any peace deal with Washington. Iran had previously threatened to intervene in support of Hezbollah if Israel continued attacks. The US and Israel have been accused by Iran of ceasefire violations, prompting Iran's move to negotiate a ceasefire. The agreement aims to halt hostilities between the parties.

stories.headline: the resignation of U.K. Prime Minister Keir Starmer
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer has announced his resignation as leader of the Labour Party, effective immediately. This decision will also see him step down as Prime Minister. Starmer cited his party's lack of confidence in his leadership as the reason for his resignation. He made the announcement outside 10 Downing Street on Monday morning. The resignation has sparked speculation about his potential successor, with Andy Burnham, a former mayor, emerging as a likely candidate. If appointed, Burnham would become the UK's seventh prime minister in a short period. Starmer's resignation comes after his election as prime minister, where he was seen as a safe pair of hands to end years of political instability. The Labour Party will now begin the process of selecting a new leader.

stories.headline: Stock Markets Today: Sensex, Nifty Flat Amidst Profit-Booking and Global Cues
stories.summary: Indian stock markets ended almost flat on Tuesday, with the Sensex closing at 82,248 and the NSE Nifty 50 edging up by 14 points to 25,496.55. The markets experienced a subdued trading session, with investors staying on the sidelines after the recent rally. Profit-booking in select heavyweights and mixed global cues contributed to the flat performance. The BSE Sensex and Nifty 50 traded in a narrow range, indicating a lack of conviction among investors. Global cues, including the ceasefire between the US and Iran, had a limited impact on the markets. Crude oil prices and other external factors are being closely watched by investors, who are awaiting clearer signals before making significant moves. The Indian stock markets are expected to stabilize after hitting record highs, with the Sensex and Nifty 50 likely to remain range-bound in the near term.

stories.headline: Stock market today: Sensex gains 300 points, Nifty 50 ends above 24,100; what moved the stock market today?
stories.summary: The Sensex gained 291 points, or 0.38%, to end at 77,094, while the Nifty 50 settled at 24,102.90, up 90 points, or 0.37%. The market's breadth improved, with the Nifty Midcap 100 and other indices also showing gains. This rally follows a sharp increase in IT and healthcare stocks, which contributed to the Nifty hitting a new all-time high, breaching 25,100. In the last two trading sessions, the Sensex added around 1,500 points, with a rise of about 500 points in one session. The current gains indicate a continued upward trend in the stock market, with key indices showing significant increases in recent trading sessions.

stories.headline: Stock Market Today, Closing Bell: Postive Ending Of Session, Sensex Jumps 250 Points, Nifty Holds Near 24,100; Pharma & IT Lead Gains
stories.summary: The Indian stock market ended on a positive note, with the Sensex jumping 250 points and the Nifty holding near 24,100. Pharma and IT sectors led the gains, driving the market upward. This comes after a significant surge yesterday, where the Sensex climbed over 1,000 points to 85,600+ and the Nifty 50 cleared 26,200, driven by broad sector gains led by metals. However, in today's session, the market witnessed a more modest increase. The Nifty held steady above 24,100 at midday, with pharma and IT leading the gains and strong market breadth. The Sensex and Nifty have been volatile in recent sessions, with significant fluctuations in the past few days. Today's positive close indicates a continued upward trend in the market.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty: Why a sharp stock market rally is unlikely in near future
stories.summary: The Indian stock market is unlikely to experience a sharp rally in the near future. According to Nuvama, markets may remain range-bound due to high valuations and shifting risks from supply to demand. Despite a potential gap-up opening, caution persists due to global uncertainties. The Sensex and Nifty have been range-bound, indicating no significant fear of wild volatility in either direction. Market participants are pricing in a favorable near-term outlook, but global uncertainties are tempering expectations. The NIFTY 50 is expected to see a gap-up opening, but overall, the market outlook suggests a stable, range-bound trajectory rather than a sharp rally. High valuations and demand-side risks are contributing factors to this forecast, indicating a period of steady, rather than spectacular, market performance.

stories.headline: Air Canada Welcomes Ratification of Two New Contracts with its Finance and Clerical Employees
stories.summary: Air Canada has announced the ratification of two new contracts with its finance and clerical employees. The contracts, which were tentative agreements reached on June 12, cover approximately 285 employees, including 170 finance personnel and 115 clerical staff. The International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers (IAMAW) represents these employees, as well as over 11,000 others in maintenance, airport airside operations, cargo, and cabin services. Ratification of the two contracts has been completed, while a third tentative agreement covering the remaining 11,000 employees is still in the process of being ratified. The ratified contracts are for finance and clerical employees, marking a significant step in labor negotiations between Air Canada and the IAMAW.

stories.headline: 'Poison in your coffee' report sounds alarm over widespread pesticide use
stories.summary: A report by Coffee Watch, an NGO, has raised concerns over the widespread use of pesticides in coffee production worldwide. The report, "Poison in Your Coffee", compiled from hundreds of scientific studies, highlights the health and environmental damage caused by intensive coffee farming. Millions of farm workers are exposed to harmful chemicals, and pesticide residues are found in exported coffee beans. The biggest concern is not the residue in consumers' cups, but the harm to farm workers and the environment. The report warns of the risks associated with pesticide use in coffee production, emphasizing the need for safer practices to protect workers and the environment. The use of pesticides in coffee farming poses significant health and environmental risks, according to the report's findings.

stories.headline: BRCB DEADLINE ALERT: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Black Rock Coffee (BRCB) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on August 17, 2026
stories.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP, a national securities law firm, is investigating potential claims against Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. (NASDAQ: BRCB) and reminds investors of the August 17, 2026 deadline to seek the role of lead plaintiff in a federal securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that Black Rock Coffee and its executives made false and misleading statements to investors in connection with the Company's September 2025 IPO. Specifically, the complaint claims that the Company overstated the effectiveness of its expansion strategy and concealed issues that would impact its business. The securities class action was filed against the Company, and investors who purchased BRCB securities during the relevant period may be eligible to participate. The deadline for seeking appointment as lead plaintiff is August 17, 2026.

stories.headline: Vobile Launches Real-World Asset Program for Creative IP Rights, Expanding Monetization Opportunities for Content Creators
stories.summary: Vobile has launched a Real-World Asset Program for creative IP rights, enabling rightsholders to monetize their intellectual property through digital asset infrastructure. The initiative allows content creators to realize value from their IP, expanding their monetization opportunities. As a leading global provider of digital content asset protection and transaction software, Vobile's new program leverages its existing SaaS capabilities. The launch was announced from Santa Clara, California, with press releases issued on June 22 and 23, 2026. This move is expected to benefit content creators by providing a new channel to capitalize on their creative assets. The program utilizes digital asset infrastructure to facilitate the monetization process, further solidifying Vobile's position in the digital content protection and transaction market.

stories.headline: Markets Insider: SpaceX’s Explosive Debut Proves Investors Are Hungry for OpenAI and Anthropic IPOs
stories.summary: SpaceX's recent initial public offering (IPO) has seen a strong market debut, with one of the highest price rallies in recent history. This success indicates investor appetite for upcoming IPOs from similar companies, including OpenAI and Anthropic. The three companies are expected to collectively raise $200 billion and add $4 trillion to the US stock market capitalization. SpaceX has also agreed to acquire Anysphere, the company behind the AI coding agent Cursor, in a $60 billion deal. The upcoming IPOs of SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI are anticipated to significantly impact the stock market, with concerns about the market's ability to absorb the large influx of equity. The surge in AI and chip stocks has been notable in 2026, with investment exceeding that of the Australian mining boom 15 years ago.

stories.headline: NDTV Profit: Getty Images Shares Soar 200% After OpenAI Strikes Licensing Deal
stories.summary: Getty Images Holdings Inc. shares soared as much as 200% in premarket trading after the company announced a licensing deal with OpenAI. The stock-photo company's shares had previously plunged due to fears that OpenAI and other artificial intelligence developers would poach its business. The licensing agreement allows Getty Images' content to appear in ChatGPT, a platform developed by OpenAI. On Monday, shares of Getty Images increased by as much as 145% following the announcement. The deal is seen as a significant development for Getty Images, which had faced concerns about the impact of AI on its business. The company's stock surge reflects the positive market reaction to the licensing agreement with OpenAI. Getty Images' licensed content will be used in ChatGPT, potentially expanding its reach and revenue.

stories.headline: BOL News: OpenAI signs AI deal with Samsung Korea for ChatGPT & Codex rollout
stories.summary: OpenAI has signed a deal with Samsung Korea to roll out ChatGPT and Codex to all Samsung employees. The partnership is part of OpenAI's Stargate initiative, which aims to accelerate AI adoption. Samsung will make ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex available to its employees, enhancing the company's internal AI capabilities. The deal is expected to bolster Samsung's AI infrastructure and support the development of AI data centers. Additionally, Samsung SDS is exploring a separate collaboration with OpenAI to jointly develop AI data centers and provide enterprise AI services. The partnership has positively impacted Samsung's stock, with shares rising close to 5% following the announcement. The deal marks a significant step in Samsung's efforts to accelerate AI adoption and enhance its technological capabilities.

stories.headline: The Indian Express: Why former OpenAI researcher Shyamal Anadkat left Silicon Valley for India
stories.summary: Shyamal Anadkat, a former researcher at OpenAI, has left Silicon Valley for India after nearly four years in the San Francisco Bay Area. Anadkat, who led OpenAI's Applied Evals team, cited a desire for family time and a strong connection to India's growing ecosystem as reasons for his move. Having grown up in India, he felt a sense of belonging and wanted to be part of the country's burgeoning tech scene. Anadkat's decision to return to India highlights the growing appeal of the country's tech industry, which is attracting talent from around the world, including those who have worked in prominent tech hubs like Silicon Valley. His move is seen as a significant development, with potential implications for India's tech landscape and its ability to retain and attract top talent.
